  • Oferecemos Vale-Refeição para você aproveitar em lojas e lanchonetes, mas se você curte cozinhar em casa, pode substituí-lo pelo Vale-Alimentação no mesmo valor ou pedir meio a meio (50% vale-refeição e 50% vale-alimentação), facilitando a vida de quem está 100% remoto ou no trabalho híbrido;
  • Falando em Saúde, oferecemos Assistência Médica, Odontológica e Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Também oferecemos assistência farmacológica e vacinas;
  • Para cuidar da sua saúde mental, temos o serviço de Psicologia e Psiquiatria online;
  • Você pode fazer consultas médicas sem sair de casa com a Telemedicina, diversos profissionais da saúde prestam atendimento online de forma prática e rápida;
  • Oferecemos a Valia, que é um Plano de Previdência Privada que visa proporcionar segurança econômica e financeira aos participantes para quando se aposentarem. É composto por contribuições do empregado e da empresa, a patrocinadora.
  • A sua educação e seu crescimento é incentivado aqui na nossa empresa, por isso temos o Auxílio Educacional que oferece uma ajuda nas mensalidades da sua graduação e pós graduação;
  • A educação dos pequenos também é importe e por isso oferecemos Auxílio Creche;
  • Esse é um assunto no qual não curtimos muito, mas é um benefício essencial, o Auxílio funeral para que você tenha toda ajuda necessária nos momentos difíceis;
  • Mas falando em festa, o Benefício de Natal está aí para fazer a sua ceia de fim de ano ficar mais apetitosa e o melhor, seus filhos e enteados menores de 10 anos também tem direito ao benefício;
  • Oferecemos o benefício Associação ao PASA, o empregado associado assegura o benefício em saúde para si a partir do desligamento da empresa sem justa causa ou por aposentadoria, quando não mais terá direito ao AMS; e possibilita a inscrição de parentes até o quarto grau (consulte condições) como usuários dos planos. Além disso, poderá fazer parte de um Clube de Benefícios bem diferenciado.
  • Para esse momento super especial na vida de uma nova mamãe com a chegada de um bebê, o PASA oferece o Benefício Maternidade com licença estendida até 180 dias
  • E os papais também terão esse privilégio de acompanhar bem de perto seu bebê nos primeiros dias de vida com a licença estendida no Benefício Paternidade, de até 20 dias
  • E para descontrair e relaxar, aqui você tem direito ao Sesc, onde poderá ir à teatros, piscinas e diversos outros eventos divertidos;
  • Aqui no PASA incentivamos a qualidade de vida e para isso oferecemos o Wellhub para que você inicie sua vida fitness e cuide de sua saúde física;
  • Se a empresa fechar o ano no positivo, temos direito ao PGD (Programa de Gratificação por Desempenho)
  • Aqui você tem o Sicoob Coopvale que é uma cooperativa financeira que oferece aos empregados e dependentes do PASA, desde que sejam associados, os mesmos serviços disponibilizados por bancos comerciais com taxas mais justas, como empréstimos, investimentos, seguro auto, de vida e residencial, assistência funeral, previdência privada, consórcios, além de dar descontos aos filiados em estabelecimentos conveniados, como óticas, papelarias, universidades, entre outros
  • Todo mundo faz aniversário, né? Nosso presente para você é um Day Off de Aniversário, para que comemore do jeito que preferir, com quem mais ama;
  • Para o deslocamento para o escritório, oferecemos Vale-Transporte

Somos uma Associação na qual as pessoas podem confiar. Confiar suas vidas, suas famílias e o seu futuro. Somos um benefício exclusivo, que oferece um serviço atencioso de qualidade para todos que fizeram e fazem parte da empresa Vale. A exclusividade de ter mais do que um plano de saúde tem nome e se chama: PASA.

O Plano de Assistência de Saúde ao Aposentado Vale (PASA) foi criado em 1991 como forma de garantir que os aposentados da companhia e seus familiares continuassem a desfrutar de um atendimento de alto nível na área da saúde. A operadora superou as melhores expectativas e se tornou uma iniciativa de sucesso no segmento de autogestão.

Nossa missão é "Oferecer o melhor cuidado com o máximo de carinho"

Agimos de maneira acolhedora e buscamos que todas as pessoas se sintam seguras e confiantes em fazer parte do PASA. Nosso intuito é proporcionar que cada pessoa aproveite o melhor da vida, sem preocupações com o acesso à saúde.

Com o esforço conjunto de mais de 300 empregados, trabalhamos para que os associados e usuários tenham acesso às mais modernas inovações da medicina, ao menor custo possível, de modo que o PASA continue a cumprir com êxito a missão que lhe foi dada por seus visionários fundadores. Nossos principais objetivos para os próximos anos são:

  • Cuidar das pessoas
  • Vanguarda na gestão da saúde
  • Instituição com ação perene
  • Cliente no centro

title: Public Cloud Project Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Public Cloud Project Manager. In this position, customer relationship management and advocacy for Canonical's technical assets are crucial. This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and Project Management to build a career with Canonical.   If you have an affinity for software, great communication skills, and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Public Cloud Project Managers provide account leadership and insight for Canonical's key Tier 1 Enterprise Public Cloud accounts. This role will collaborate with individuals from Software Engineering through Senior Level Executives.  

As a Public Cloud Project Manager, you will manage multiple blue-chip company projects simultaneously. Working with all stakeholders, you will shape the SoW or similar agreements with our clients, manage projects through their life-cycles, ensuring the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met. 

Periodic international travel is required. Travel amount and duration will vary based on company and program requirements. 

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

The role entails

  • Ensuring programs and projects are delivered within the schedule, scope, cost, budget and resources expectations
  • Identifying key technical and project risks and issues and actively put mitigating actions in place 
  • Maintaining strong customer focus and work with all key stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes
  • Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with customers and provide direction when needed
  • Managing the delivery schedule of critical third party deliverables for the project
  • Identifying and managing cross organization engineering requests that are not part of existing business contracts.
  • Advocating to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's portfolio 

What we are looking for in you

  • Proven background in IT Cloud industry as a software development project manager, IT program/project manager, agile software manager or scrum master
  • Deep understanding of Linux, Open source, and the Public Cloud space 
  • Software engineering experience 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience leading cross-cultural, remote and global project teams and customers.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills 
  • Strong communication skills
  • Bachelor's Degree in a STEM discipline
  • Project Management Certification, preferably PMP or equivalent certification
  • Agile Project Management certification, preferably Scrum Master or equivalent certification
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits that reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Gerente de Loja
description:
A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas,

que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente de loja para atuar na nossa loja do Barra Shopping que acreditem que é possível encantar e criar relações duradouras com nossas equipes e clientes.

Buscamos profissionais que queiram atuar em um novo modelo de relacionamento com o varejo, que ao invés de pensar somente na venda pela venda, acreditem que é possível redesenhar as relações de trabalho entre pessoas e empresas.

Nossos gerentes são responsáveis por:

  • Entregar resultado, compromisso, controle dos processos e um atendimento impecável no estilo Zerezes para atingir a melhor nota possível no NPS;
  • Garantir o bom funcionamento da estrutura física das lojas;
  • Controlar as despesas da loja no objetivo proposto;
  • Gerenciar o inventário de loja para mantê-la sempre abastecida;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores de lentes e outros terceiros e orientar equipe no cumprimento dos prazos de montagens de óculos e de consertos;
  • Seguir as metas e os indicadores de desempenho que valorizem o profissional completo, com avaliações mensais de cada colaborador, indicando o caminho para o desenvolvimento e crescimento na marca;

Para ser gerente na Zerezes é essencial que você tenha:

  • Vasto conhecimento em indicadores de desempenho comercial;
  • Experiência anterior em cargo de gestão com bastante foco em desenvolvimento de equipes;
  • Experiência em gestão no ramo óptico é um diferencial

Trabalhar conosco te garante alguns benefícios, são eles:

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco Efetivo (enfermaria);
  • Vale Refeição — R$ 25 por dia no cartão CAJU;
  • Vale Transporte — conforme a necessidade do funcionário depositado no cartão CAJU com desconto em folha conforme a lei;
  • Wellhub (antigo gympass);
  • Conexa saúde (beneficio de saúde mental, desconto em farmácias e exames);
  • On Happy (desconto em viagens a lazer)
  • Programa de desconto nos produtos Zerezes

A Zerezes nasceu do design, e da vontade de fazer diferente. A gente acredita que óculos são mais do que itens funcionais: são extensão de quem somos. Por isso, queremos transformar a forma como as pessoas se relacionam com eles.

O nosso jeito de trabalhar é leve, colaborativo e com propósito. Valorizamos quem tem curiosidade, busca aprender, se importa com o outro e quer deixar uma marca positiva por onde passa.

Aqui, cada pessoa conta. E a gente cresce junto, com transparência, impacto real e vontade de fazer bonito, sempre.

Nossos valores

Fazer coisas memoráveis.

A gente gosta de fazer diferente, com criatividade, impacto real e propósito.

Abertura para aprender.

Somos curiosos por natureza. Escutamos, testamos, ajustamos e seguimos em frente.

Transparência radical.

Falamos com clareza e respeito. O combinado não sai caro, e o feedback aqui é ferramenta de crescimento.

Tratar os outros como gostaríamos de ser tratados.

Empatia e escuta são base de tudo. A gente constrói junto e valoriza cada ponto de vista.

Bom para o mundo.

Nosso impacto vai além dos óculos. Queremos gerar valor pra quem tá com a gente, seja dentro ou fora da Zerezes.

Vamos juntos?

Se você acredita que trabalho pode ser leve sem deixar de ser sério, que dá pra fazer bonito sem perder a simplicidade, e que ótica pode ser muito mais do que só vender óculos…

A Zerezes pode ser o seu lugar

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We're scaling
Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW)
in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold:
to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils
in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We're doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we're growing fast.

Our company culture blends
people-first care
and
performance excellence.
The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We're proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people experience the interview process with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

Informative Video by Matyas

Hybrid, with travel in Brazil

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)

Language Skills: Must: Portuguese, English (fluent)

Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We are searching for a
seasoned, strategic, commercial, and hands-on COO
to lead and shape our
go-to-market strategy
for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across
agricultural
and
mining sectors
and evolve our operational backbone. In this role, you'll oversee our entire value chain - from mineral inputs and field operations to our internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine
product-market fit
, identify
scalable customer use cases,
lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling
in one of the world's most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our
Chief Impact Officer
and
Head of Operations
, who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You'll work hand-in-hand with our
VP of Science
, ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you'll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real
agronomic value
while meeting carbon certification requirements. You'll be responsible for orchestrating our
1-100 scale-up journey
: evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We're at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a
strong operational track record
, ideally in
Brazilian agribusiness
, and can bridge
execution with innovation.

You will report directly to the
CEO
and be a critical member of our
Senior Leadership Team
alongside our CFO. You'll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • Head of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Our Science team, in close partnership with the VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners

You'll play a central role in
aligning science, fieldwork, and operations
, ensuring we stay ahead in the rapidly evolving climate and carbon removal landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • You'll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet's carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • You'll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You'll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • You'll build a leadership culture that's entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You've scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to "get your boots dirty" when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Hybrid Remote: ideally around Sao Paulo
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil yay
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

The ideal candidate is a strategic communicator who can think like a businessperson, ask unexpected questions, and provide consultative value during every interaction.

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).Requisitos:- Curso técnico em mecânica;

description:
We are seeking an AI-focused Technical Manager / Product Owner to lead delivery for multiple AI initiatives. This role blends product ownership, delivery management, and AI-savvy stakeholder leadership. You'll own outcomes, organize work for fast iteration, manage expectations with demanding business and technology partners, and collaborate closely with an AI Architect and engineering leads to turn AI opportunities into clear, shippable increments. You are comfortable moving at a high tempo, getting to the point quickly, and keeping teams and stakeholders aligned while AI projects evolve rapidly. Own the order of work: define MVP, prioritize by impact and effort, and ensure the first outcomes are meaningful and measurable. Manage expectations with business, technical, and partner stakeholders (including large cloud/enterprise partners) around scope, tradeoffs, and timelines. Act as POPM/PO across one or two concurrent AI projects, maintaining visibility, momentum, and alignment. Collaborate with an AI Architect and engineering leads to align business outcomes with technical implementation, without needing to be a hands-on developer. Facilitate Sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives with a focus on outcomes, learning, and velocity rather than ceremony. Anticipate risks and issues ahead of time rather than reacting late;
surface them clearly and propose actionable options. Ensure that business outcomes, user value, and AI capabilities are consistently connected and understood by all parties. title: Senior Ux/Ui Designer
description: About Us Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps. We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product. A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand. The Mission We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division. Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools. You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site. Key Responsibilities Scalable Theme Architecture: Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress). Visual Excellence & Conversion: Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion. SEO & Performance by Design: Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system. Production-First Thinking: Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof. Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader. Iteration & Improvement: Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability. What Makes You the Right Fit? This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking. Must-Haves: 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design). A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate: Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides). Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design. A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions. Expert-level proficiency in Figma, Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.G., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS. Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory. Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one. Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams. A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail. A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles. Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves): Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.). Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools. What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience. 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays. Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference. Why Join Us? Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country. A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality. Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up. How to Apply If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work. Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency. Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

Realizar análise de petróleo e derivados como: diesel, nafta, gasóleos e lubrificantes, dentre outras matrizes, avaliar consistência dos dados, emitir laudos de análise, especificar tecnicamente e encaminhar solicitações de compras de equipamentos e insumos em atendimento às exigências da legislação vigente e de forma a garantir a confiabilidade analítica do laboratório;
Preparo e análise dealíquotas de amostras de produtos (material de referência) e padrões de referência, bem como suas análises, para o Controle Estatístico de Processos (CEP) dos serviços de Análises por Cromatografia Líquida – construção de curvas de calibração, validação de equipamentos e métodos analíticos;
Construção, execuçãoe manutenção de ferramentas de controle e garantia da qualidade de resultados analíticos (cartas de controle, curvas de calibração, controle de padrões certificados etc.), bem como quaisquer ações necessárias para viabilizar a gestão da qualidade;
Preparo de amostras (pesagem, centrifugação, precipitação, filtração, extração com solventes, extração em fase sólida e quaisquer outras operações unitárias necessárias para adequação da amostra original ao método analítico instrumental que suportará o atendimento solicitado, não exclusivo a métodos cromatográficos);
Fracionamento e análise de amostras orgânicas por cromatografia líquida (MPLC, HPLC e preparativa/gravimétrica);
Aferição das vidrarias de precisão, no ato do recebimento ou sob demanda específica;
Alimentação debases de dados por uso de softwares de aplicação à laboratórios de análises químicas;
Manutenção básica operacional de Cromatógrafos e outros equipamentos analíticos, configuração básica de hardware e software;
Solicitar e acompanhar manutenção das instalações, equipamentos e fornecimento de consumíveis;
Gestão das amostras no laboratório, incluindo recebimento, aceitação e armazenamento adequado das amostras, cadastro de amostras, solicitação de ensaios, emissão de resultados, devolução de amostras já concluídas no sistema de gerenciamento de informações de laboratório (LIMS) vigente;
Gestão e controle deestoque e orçamentação de insumos (reagentes, padrões etc.), peças e equipamentos laboratoriais;
Coordenação, execução, atualização e confecção de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrões pertinentes às rotinas laboratoriais;
Coordenação e execução de descartes de resíduos laboratoriais;
Zelar, executar e garantir o cumprimento das normas e requisitos de segurança do laboratório e liberação de serviços no local;
Coordenação detreinamentos necessários para capacitação de técnicos na execução das análises e metodologias analíticas por Cromatografia Líquida;
Realizar visitas técnicas externas para acompanhamento e execução de serviços ou incorporação de tecnologias;
Otimização dosrecursos e infraestrutura laboratoriais para produção analítica;
Dominar ferramentas de suporte ao processamento dos dados, compilação e apresentação de resultados, como: MS Office, Chemstation/EZChrom (OpenLab);
Emissão de relatórios e/ou laudos (certificados) de análise em português e/ou Inglês;
Demais atividades necessárias à execução dos serviços acima mencionados. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Formação: Graduação Completa em Química. Experiência: Vivência mínima de 6 anos em cromatografia líquida de alta eficiência ou 5 anos de vivência em alguma das técnicas abaixo: 1.Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (HPLC);
2.Cromatografia em Fluido Supercrítico (SFC-FID);

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando: Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh, com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. title: Global Project Coordinator - Operations
description: Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide. Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics. Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators. IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed. Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents,

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Buscamos Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore para uma das nossas unidades:

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Reportar imediatamente ao Gerente da unidade qualquer risco real ou potencial observado durante a execução de qualquer atividade, paralisando o serviço caso o risco seja iminente.
  • Treinar, orientar e compor o time de resposta a emergência da unidade nas ações específicas de resposta, organizando e participando dos exercícios e simulados de emergência.
  • Realizar palestras e treinamentos de segurança e meio ambiente conforme demanda.
  • Coordenar e apoiar o Gerente da unidade e demais departamentos nas ações referentes às políticas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.
  • Disseminar a cultura de segurança, através de ações para promover a segurança entre nossos colaboradores, com o objetivo de difundir os princípios de segurança e fundamentos de segurança de processo.
  • Coordenar as auditorias de Permissões de trabalho e inspeções nos equipamentos e sistemas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar o atendimento à Matriz de Treinamento da equipe de bordo.
  • Assegurar que a equipe de técnicos de segurança seja treinada e capacitada na aplicação das ferramentas de gestão tais como Greendocs, procedimentos, sistema de PT digital, cartão de observação, registros de incidentes, inspeções rotineiras, listas de verificações, análises de riscos, permissões de trabalho, entre outros, por meio de treinamentos internos definidos nos procedimentos estabelecidos pela organização.
  • Contribuir e ser o facilitador nas investigações de acidentes/incidentes junto à operação, propondo ações de melhorias por meio de técnicas de análises eficazes que garantam a redução e/ou eliminação dos eventos indesejáveis.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico)

  • Formação técnica de Segurança do Trabalho.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória

  • Sólida experiência como Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore e com liderança de times.
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, queremos saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub‑projects.
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement and customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with involved government authorities to ensure smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking within the warehouse and across all venues where assets are provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managing the entry of delivery and collection vehicles into venues during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.
  • Where required, development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP), and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf‑cart pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy in cooperation with tournament management, legal, procurement and all item‑procurement functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking and people resources as required.
  • Managing established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf‑cart provider) and ensuring all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Providing the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration‑management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attending site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meetings and events where an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g., Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics project plan, including mitigation and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruiting the Logistics team and providing leadership to the team.
  • Preparing and managing a health‑and‑safety plan.
  • Preparing and managing a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Providing timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Completing the final reconciliation, closing contracts and transferring knowledge post‑tournaments.
Your Profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics or event operations for an international event.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.
Seniority level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Job function

Management and Manufacturing

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Overview

Tudo o que fazemos é por acreditar que existe um grande potencial não explorado em cada ser humano. Nosso propósito é transformar a vida das pessoas ao descobrir sua melhor versão. Somos o melhor curso de comunicação e oratória do Brasil; ajudamos pessoas e empresas a melhorarem suas performances e resultados através de uma metodologia única e inovadora que combina técnicas de oratória, fonoaudiologia, neurociência, psicologia positiva e técnicas teatrais.

Nossa cultura: No nosso dia a dia, nos propomos a fazer diferente na vida dos nossos clientes e colaboradores de forma única e eficiente, porque acreditamos que cada ser humano é único e tem grande potencial a ser descoberto e desenvolvido. Isso se tangibiliza em atitudes práticas e em nossos valores:

  • Excelência: Ter compromisso por fazer o melhor, sempre. Valorizar o cuidado com os detalhes e a busca constante pela alta qualidade em tudo o que faz.
  • Coragem: Encarar as mudanças e desafios de frente, com confiança e determinação, acreditando que cada adversidade é uma oportunidade para o crescimento e transformação.
  • Inovação: Inovar com paixão e estar sempre em busca de novas ideias e soluções que tragam resultados impactantes, transformando vidas.
  • Sabedoria: Aprender e crescer continuamente. Investir em conhecimento e desenvolvimento e garantir o sucesso em tudo o que se propõe a fazer.
  • Bom humor: Cultivar um ambiente leve e descontraído. Saber encarar os desafios com positividade e leveza.
  • Acolhimento: Priorizar as pessoas, cuidar das relações e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho saudável.

Seus Principais Objetivos São:

  • Conectar com leads quentes e frios, com foco em gerar novas oportunidades de negócios;
  • Qualificar prospects e entender suas necessidades;
  • Aprimoramento e captação de informações comerciais;
  • Mapear oportunidades de venda e realizar a oferta de nossos produtos/serviços;
  • Agendar reunião para fechamento da venda entre o potencial cliente e nossos executivos de venda;
  • Qualificar e desenvolver os leads gerados por nossas estratégias de marketing;
  • Atualizar as informações no CRM e softwares de sales engagement com pontos relevantes sobre as oportunidades identificadas;
  • Trabalhar o social selling e aprofundar relacionamento com os leads por meio de canais sociais.

Procuramos por Pessoas (atentem-se às soft skills abaixo):

  • Pessoas com raciocínio lógico;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Ótima dicção;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão sistêmica;
  • Solucionadoras de problemas;
  • Criativas e empreendedoras;
  • Organizadas e disciplinadas para contribuir com a performance do time;
  • Que AMEM trabalhar em equipe (aqui não aceitamos egoísmo, nem competições não saudáveis);
  • Resilientes e Pacientes (confortáveis no desconforto e lidando com o desconhecido);
  • Proativas e Independentes (com vontade de aprender e resolver problemas de forma autônoma);
  • Que tenham espírito empreendedor.

  • Pacote Office básico;

  • Facilidade em aprender coisas novas.

Diferenciais:

  • Noções básicas de inglês; Experiência como SDR;
  • Conhecimento prévio na metodologia SPIN Selling;
  • Conhecimento de CRM.

Join to apply for the Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle role at Águas do Rio .

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

O Programa Respeito dá o Tom nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Principal Platform Engineer, Americas
description:
We’re looking for a curious, rigorous, problem-hungry platform engineer (who codes!) to carry the ball as we bring Ashby to the big leagues. Ashby builds software that lets talent teams build an efficient, delightful, respectful hiring process. Similarly, you’re an engineer who wants to build a “paved road” that excellent engineering teams can safely take to the moon and back.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we’re hiring for this role.

We’ve listed this role twice: as a Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer – our team does both, and we are open to candidates who lean towards one or the other.

About the role and how we work

Hi I’m Colin, Head of EMEA Engineering. I’ve spent a number of years leading engineering teams in startups, and that has always included being close to infrastructure teams - no matter what name they’ve worn (SRE, infrastructure, platform, etc). I’ve got my hands dirty building the initial infrastructure for startups and know the value a talented infrastructure engineer brings. The rigour, the discipline, the peace and quiet when everything just hums along.

Our infrastructure is in a good place for now. Nothing is static. Ashby continues to grow rapidly, putting strain on our existing infrastructure. We’re always looking to give our customers more powerful hiring software, and building new product features often requires new pieces of infrastructure.

Having herded plenty of snowflake servers in the past, I’ve learned there’s a better way. I (and Ashby) place a lot of value on code-as-infrastructure. As a Platform Engineer at Ashby, you’ll get to dive into scaling problems, add new capabilities to our platform, and think about how our entire team interacts with infrastructure. All our own engineers own their projects end-to-end and ship with minimal oversight. We don’t put roadblocks to ensure security when common sense will do and we don’t build processes like change management boards around the lowest common denominator. But with great power comes great responsibility: we handle personal and confidential data about some of the biggest decisions we ever make at work. As we grow, more and bigger customers rely on us to be reliable and secure and how we operate internally will need to evolve.

We’re at an inflection point where our ability to scale and deliver a seamless experience has a make-or-break impact – we have some of the fastest growing companies using our platform every day to hire hundreds of people per month. We need someone like you to make good decisions, debug thorny issues, and build us a future-proof platform that can withstand this scale. Our small but mighty infrastructure team has set up a secure and simple environment (we don’t believe in spinning up a new service unless necessary!) for our growing product team to build in. That’s where you come in: you, too, will own projects end-to-end and have an impact on core parts of the Ashby developer and user experience. For instance, you could work on:

  • Optimize our homegrown ultra-dynamic recruiting DSL-to-SQL compiler, and create tools to help developers do so
  • Create automated guardrails for the security and privacy of our customer data
  • Help our developers ship features fast through canary deploys, gradual rollouts and feature flags, while keeping complexity manageable and reducing downtime
  • Work with the business and the engineering team to define SLOs and implement the corresponding SLIs.
  • Ensure all communication with external services supports circuit-breakers.
  • Implement the infrastructure to support an event-driven architecture and data warehouse.
Why you should or shouldn’t apply

You should apply if:

  • You never stop. You get weirdly obsessed about a problem that doesn’t yet make sense, turn it every which way in your head until the explanation dawns. You’ll search every rock, inventory every clue, hunt every mismatch. We do that, too – together we’ll be armed with state‑of‑the‑art monitoring tools and an impressive amount of data, and join you in the adventure.
  • You don’t take shortcuts. You’re speaking up for the future user, the edge case, the doomsday design. You know product engineers want to build it with you, and see them as allies, where you give them the power and knowledge to access greater things.
  • You’re someone who cares about what you do and the team you do it with, and want to work with others who do as well. You’ll be on interview panels choosing your next colleagues, and you’ll take that seriously. You only want to work with people who make you better, and want to make you better.
  • You’ve built infrastructure at a slightly later stage than Ashby is at - you know how to deal with millions of data points, have seen great (or not great) infrastructure make or break customer experience, and have automated everything from provisioning to monitoring and release process.
  • You’re a Swiss army knife (all nationalities welcome). You’ll get every hard problem the company faces. You’ll get to do infrastructure updates, security enforcements, database optimization, Kubernetes debugging, and digging through Typescript traces figuring out what doesn’t work. You probably don’t feel like an expert at at least some of that… and that appeals to you.

You should not apply if:

  • You don’t want to make your own decisions on what is the best paved road to build for Ashby, and expect a lead or manager to make the final call on what that is. Our leads (and managers) give ample commentary and feedback on technical decisions and how they’re made, but you ship what you want to build and are accountable for it.
  • You hate SQL. We have a lot of features built around making the best out of data, and our platform engineers also sometimes dive into a gnarly report or advise engineers on a more performant data model to use.
  • You don’t want to code. Our SREs are some of our best software engineers and they are just as responsible for the application as the other engineering teams – albeit at a platform level. Reviewing code and submitting code changes will be part of your day to day.
  • Your primary mode of communicating best practices to engineers is live meetings. We’re a very async culture and written communication (and code) is how changes get made. As an Ashby SRE, you will need to share new tooling and best practices with engineers faster than your next meeting opportunity will take you.
  • You’ve never delivered a project, on your own, without someone prodding you for updates. We have no project or delivery managers to fill your calendar with busy work, but the flip side is you have to do your project management, seek the help you need to get unstuck and cut scope when it’s worthwhile.
Technology Stack

We use TypeScript (frontend & backend), Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Redis. We use Datadog and Sentry on 100% cloud‑based (AWS) infra. We take developer experience and reliability seriously: all engineers are on call in a follow‑the‑sun model, and everyone contributes to developer tooling.

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top‑tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high‑quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
